detail: Full summary: the harness's .twining/config.yml carries a stale priority-weight key 'graph_connectivity' — the real key is 'graph_reachability', which the loader therefore sets to 0. Graph-based ranking has been silently disabled in the harness's own store. Not fixed; flagged because the same class of key drift could exist in field configs.
